cjpais/handy.creator: robfusco_
cjpais/handy.caption:
Handy, a free, open-source alternative to Wispr Flow.

Hold a shortcut, talk, let go, and your words get typed into whatever app you’re in (email, docs, AI chats).
It runs on your own computer, so your voice never goes to the cloud. Works offline.

Mac, Windows and Linux. Free, MIT license.
